def _on_amcl(self, msg: PoseWithCovarianceStamped) -> None:
        stamp = msg.header.stamp.sec * 1_000_000_000 + msg.header.stamp.nanosec
        self._focal_amcl_seen_stamp_ns = stamp
        # Isolated robustness input: retain only this node's AMCL planning cache.
        # The actual AMCL node and its TF publications are unchanged.
        if self.awaiting:
            self._focal_amcl_held_count = getattr(self, '_focal_amcl_held_count', 0) + 1
            return
        self._focal_amcl_cache_stamp_ns = stamp
        self.robot_xy = (msg.pose.pose.position.x, msg.pose.pose.position.y)
        self.robot_yaw = _yaw_from_quat(msg.pose.pose.orientation)
